d1.title: Baseline & Focus Warm-Up
d1.focus: Establish your true baseline WPM and comprehension score, then begin waking up your visual system.

d2.title: Focus Foundation
d2.focus: Warm up your attention with a number hunt, learn the Story method for remembering lists, then practise chunk reading.

d3.title: First Visual Focus Session
d3.focus: Introduce visual, non-verbal recall alongside your reading warm-ups.

d4.title: Rhythm & Chunk Awareness
d4.focus: Start noticing word groups instead of single words.

d5.title: Visualization Opens
d5.focus: Begin practising clear pictures in your mind.

d6.title: Foundation Consolidation
d6.focus: Reinforce the week's gains with a full balanced circuit.

d7.title: Checkpoint — Foundation Review
d7.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-one growth.

d9.title: Inner Voice Awareness
d9.focus: Start noticing and interrupting your inner voice while reading.

d10.title: Flash Reading Warm-Up
d10.focus: Sharpen instant recognition speed with flash-based drills.

d11.title: Deeper Visual Focus Practice
d11.focus: Remember new names and faces, and keep your reading focus deep.

d12.title: Inner Voice Control
d12.focus: Push further into silent, voice-free reading.

d13.title: Integration Circuit
d13.focus: Combine visual-focus and reading gains in one balanced session.

d14.title: Checkpoint — Visual Focus Review
d14.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-two growth.

d15.title: Keyword Method Begins
d15.focus: Make your Memory Palace more vivid: use sight, sound and touch to fix each object in its place.

d16.title: Calm & Steady Focus
d16.focus: Settle your mind with guided slow breathing, then train focus and memory.

d17.title: Build Your Own Memory Palace
d17.focus: Layer visualization work on top of your reading gains.

d18.title: Full Sensory Immersion
d18.focus: Picture scenes vividly and recall their details.

d19.title: Steady Under Pressure
d19.focus: Keep your attention steady as the drills get quicker.

d20.title: Integrated Focus Circuit
d20.focus: Combine calm breathing, memory and reading in one advanced session.

d21.title: Checkpoint — Week Three Review
d21.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-three growth.

d22.title: Your Own Book — Phrase Reading
d22.focus: Read in idea-sized phrases, not single words.

d23.title: Names Review — Multi-Line Reading
d23.focus: Extend fluency across multiple lines at once.

d24.title: Numbers Review — Sentence Reading
d24.focus: Recognize whole sentences as single ideas.

d25.title: Keyword Review — Paragraph Reading
d25.focus: Recognize whole paragraphs as single meaning blocks.

d26.title: Palace Review — Word Flash Reading
d26.focus: Recognise words at a glance while keeping accuracy high.

d27.title: Your Own Book — Number Flash
d27.focus: Take in numbers at a glance and keep accuracy high.

d28.title: Your Own Book — Calm & Symbol Flash
d28.focus: Breathe slowly, then recognise symbols quickly and accurately.

d29.title: Final Practice — Mixed Flash
d29.focus: Words, numbers and symbols at a glance — your sharpest round yet.

d30.title: Final Certification
d30.focus: Complete your final WPM and comprehension assessment and claim your Sharp Brain certification.

p1.title: Foundation: focus & reading basics
p1.description: A fair reading test on Day 1, then focus warm-ups, the Story method and your first reading drills.

p2.title: Memory techniques
p2.description: Story, Peg, Names & faces and Number pictures — one method at a time, used on real lists.

p3.title: Memory Palace, Keyword & Chapter
p3.description: Build your own memory palaces, learn the Keyword method and remember a whole chapter.

p4.title: Your own book + Day 30 test
p4.description: Use the methods on your own book, then take the Day 30 test to see how far you have come.
